vengeful-retreat.name: Vengeful Retreat
vengeful-retreat.en: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 489 Physical damage.
vengeful-retreat.desc: 移除所有减速效果并向后跳跃。附近敌人受到 489 点物理伤害。

felblade.name: Felblade
felblade.en: Charge to your target and deal 3,598 Fire damage. Generates 15 Fury.
felblade.desc: 冲向目标造成 3,598 点火焰伤害，生成 15 点怒气。

sigil-of-misery.name: Sigil of Misery
sigil-of-misery.en: Place a Sigil of Misery at the target location that activates after 2 sec. Causes all enemies affected by the sigil to cower in fear, disorienting them for 15 sec.
sigil-of-misery.desc: 在目标位置放置悲苦咒符，2 秒后激活，使受影响的所有敌人陷入恐惧，持续 15 秒。

vengeful-bonds.name: Vengeful Bonds
vengeful-bonds.en: Vengeful Retreat reduces the movement speed of all nearby enemies by 70% for 3 sec.
vengeful-bonds.desc: 复仇回避使附近所有敌人移动速度降低 70%，持续 3 秒。

shattered-restoration.name: Shattered Restoration
shattered-restoration.en: The healing of Shattered Souls is increased by 10%.
shattered-restoration.desc: Shattered Souls 的治疗效果提高 10%。

improved-sigil-of-misery.name: Improved Sigil of Misery
improved-sigil-of-misery.en: Reduces the cooldown of Sigil of Misery by 30 sec.
improved-sigil-of-misery.desc: 悲苦咒符的冷却时间降低 30 秒。

bouncing-glaives.name: Bouncing Glaives
bouncing-glaives.en: Throw Glaive ricochets to 1 additional target.
bouncing-glaives.desc: 投掷利刃额外弹跳到 1 个目标。

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.en: Imprisons a demon, beast, or humanoid, incapacitating them for 1 min. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.
imprison.desc: 禁锢一个恶魔、野兽或人型生物，使其无法行动 1 分钟。受到伤害会打断此效果。限 1 个目标。

charred-warblades.name: Charred Warblades
charred-warblades.en: You heal for 3% of all Fire damage you deal.
charred-warblades.desc: 你造成的所有火焰伤害的 3% 会治疗你。

chaos-nova.name: Chaos Nova
chaos-nova.en: Unleash an eruption of fel energy, dealing 1,485 Chaos damage and stunning all nearby enemies for 3 sec.
chaos-nova.desc: 释放邪能爆发，造成 1,485 点混乱伤害并使附近所有敌人昏迷 3 秒。

improved-disrupt.name: Improved Disrupt
improved-disrupt.en: Increases the range of Disrupt to 10 yds.
improved-disrupt.desc: 瓦解的施法距离提高到 10 码。

consume-magic.name: Consume Magic
consume-magic.en: Consume 1 beneficial Magic effect removing it from the target.
consume-magic.desc: 消耗目标身上 1 个有益魔法效果并将其移除。

aldrachi-design.name: Aldrachi Design
aldrachi-design.en: Increases your chance to parry by 3%.

focused-ire.name: Focused Ire
focused-ire.en: The primary target of Chaos Nova is stunned for an additional 2 sec.
focused-ire.desc: 混乱新星对主要目标额外昏迷 2 秒。

master-of-the-glaive.name: Master of the Glaive
master-of-the-glaive.en: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and snares all enemies hit by 50% for 6 sec.
master-of-the-glaive.desc: 投掷利刃获得 2 次充能，并使命中的所有敌人减速 50%，持续 6 秒。

disrupting-fury.name: Disrupting Fury
disrupting-fury.en: Disrupt generates 30 Fury on a successful interrupt.
disrupting-fury.desc: 瓦解成功打断时生成 30 点怒气。

blazing-path.name: Blazing Path
blazing-path.en: Fel Rush gains an additional charge.
blazing-path.desc: 邪能冲撞额外获得 1 次充能。

swallowed-anger.name: Swallowed Anger
swallowed-anger.en: Consume Magic generates 20 Fury when a beneficial Magic effect is successfully removed from the target.
swallowed-anger.desc: Consume Magic 成功移除有益魔法效果时生成 20 点怒气。

aura-of-pain.name: Aura of Pain
aura-of-pain.en: Increases the critical strike chance of Immolation Aura by 6%.
aura-of-pain.desc: 献祭光环的爆击几率提高 6%。

live-by-the-glaive.name: Live by the Glaive
live-by-the-glaive.en: When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
live-by-the-glaive.desc: 当你招架攻击或你的攻击被招架时，恢复最大生命值的 2% 和 10 点怒气。每 5 秒最多触发一次。

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.desc: 精通会提高你的移动速度。

soul-rending.name: Soul Rending
soul-rending.en: Leech increased by 10%. Gain an additional 10% leech while Metamorphosis is active.
soul-rending.desc: 吸血提高 10%，恶魔变形激活时额外再提高 10%。

felfire-haste.name: Felfire Haste
felfire-haste.en: Fel Rush increases your movement speed by 10% for 8 sec.
felfire-haste.desc: 邪能冲撞使你的移动速度提高 10%，持续 8 秒。

infernal-armor.name: Infernal Armor
infernal-armor.en: Immolation Aura increases your armor by 20% and causes melee attackers to suffer 752 Fire damage.
infernal-armor.desc: 献祭光环使你的护甲提高 20%，并使近战攻击者受到 752 点火焰伤害。

burn-it-out.name: Burn It Out
burn-it-out.desc: 献祭光环移除 1 个疾病效果。

lost-in-darkness.name: Lost in Darkness
lost-in-darkness.en: Spectral Sight has 5 sec reduced cooldown and no longer reduces movement speed.
lost-in-darkness.desc: 幽灵视觉的冷却时间降低 5 秒，且不再降低你的移动速度。

illidari-knowledge.name: Illidari Knowledge
illidari-knowledge.desc: 你受到的魔法伤害降低 12%。

felbound.name: Felbound
felbound.en: Your movement speed is increased by 3%.

furious.name: Furious
furious.en: Attacks and abilities that generate Fury deal 3% increased damage.
furious.desc: 生成怒气的攻击和技能造成的伤害提高 3%。

remorseless.name: Remorseless
remorseless.en: Attacks and abilities that spend Fury deal 3% increased damage.
remorseless.desc: 消耗怒气的攻击和技能造成的伤害提高 3%。

first-in,-last-out.name: First In, Last Out
first-in,-last-out.en: Fel Rush grants you a rapidly decaying shield equal to 6% of your maximum health.
first-in,-last-out.desc: 邪能冲撞提供相当于最大生命值 6% 的护盾，快速衰减。

erratic-felheart.name: Erratic Felheart
erratic-felheart.en: The cooldown of Fel Rush is reduced by 4.0 sec.
erratic-felheart.desc: 邪能冲撞的冷却时间降低 4 秒。

final-breath.name: Final Breath
final-breath.en: Fully channeling Eye Beam increases the damage of its final tick by 300%.
final-breath.desc: 完整引导眼棱会使其最后一跳的伤害提高 300%。

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.en: Summons darkness around you in an 8 yd radius, granting friendly targets a 25% chance to avoid all damage from an attack. Lasts 8 sec. Chance to avoid damage increased by 100% when not in a raid.
darkness.desc: 在你周围 8 码内召唤黑暗，使友方目标有 25% 几率完全避免一次攻击的伤害，持续 8 秒。不在团队副本中时此几率提高 100%。

demon-muzzle.name: Demon Muzzle
demon-muzzle.en: Interrupting a spell with Disrupt decreases your magic damage taken by 5% for 12 sec.
demon-muzzle.desc: 用瓦解打断法术后，你受到的魔法伤害降低 5%，持续 12 秒。

soul-splitter.name: Soul Splitter
soul-splitter.en: Any time you would generate one or more Soul Fragments, you have a 8% chance to generate an additional Soul Fragment.
soul-splitter.desc: 每当你生成灵魂碎片时，有 8% 几率额外生成一个。

pitch-black.name: Pitch Black
pitch-black.en: Reduces the cooldown of Darkness by 120 sec.
pitch-black.desc: 黑暗的冷却时间降低 120 秒。

demonic-resilience.name: Demonic Resilience
demonic-resilience.desc: 疾影额外获得 1 次充能。

eye-beam.name: Eye Beam
eye-beam.en: Blasts all enemies in front of you, for up to 70,771 Chaos damage over 2.3 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec.
eye-beam.desc: 轰击你前方所有敌人，在 2.3 秒内造成最多 70,771 点混乱伤害。超过 5 个目标后伤害降低。完整引导后你的急速额外提高 8%，持续 8 秒。

critical-chaos.name: Critical Chaos
critical-chaos.en: The chance that Chaos Strike will refund 20 Fury is increased by 30% of your critical strike chance.
critical-chaos.desc: 混乱打击返还 20 点怒气的几率按你爆击几率的 30% 提高。

burning-hatred.name: Burning Hatred
burning-hatred.en: Immolation Aura generates an additional 30 Fury over 10 sec.
burning-hatred.desc: 献祭光环在 10 秒内额外生成 30 点怒气。

never-say-die.name: Never Say Die
never-say-die.en: Damage is increased by 3% while above 50% Health. Leech is increased by 5% while below 50% Health.
never-say-die.desc: 生命值高于 50% 时伤害提高 3%；低于 50% 时吸血提高 5%。

first-blood.name: First Blood
first-blood.en: Blade Dance deals 29,232 Chaos damage to the first target struck.
first-blood.desc: 刃舞对首个命中的目标造成 29,232 点混乱伤害。

accelerated-blade.name: Accelerated Blade
accelerated-blade.en: Throw Glaive deals 60% increased damage, reduced by 30% for each previous enemy hit.
accelerated-blade.desc: 投掷利刃的伤害提高 60%，每多命中一个之前的敌人降低 30%。

demon-hide.name: Demon Hide
demon-hide.en: Magical damage increased by 3%, and Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
demon-hide.desc: 魔法伤害提高 3%，受到的物理伤害降低 5%。

desperate-instincts.name: Desperate Instincts
desperate-instincts.en: Blur now reduces damage taken by an additional 10%. Additionally, damage taken below 35% Health is reduced by 10%.
desperate-instincts.desc: 疾影额外降低受到的伤害 10%。此外生命值低于 35% 时，受到的伤害降低 10%。

mortal-dance.name: Mortal Dance
mortal-dance.en: Blade Dance now reduces targets' healing received by 25% for 6 sec.
mortal-dance.desc: 刃舞使目标受到的治疗降低 25%，持续 6 秒。

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.en: Damaging an enemy before they damage you increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec. Vengeful Retreat refreshes your potential to trigger this effect on any enemies you are in combat with.
initiative.desc: 在敌人伤害你之前先伤害他，可使你的爆击几率提高 10%，持续 5 秒。复仇回避会刷新你对所有交战敌人触发此效果的机会。

scars-of-suffering.name: Scars of Suffering
scars-of-suffering.en: Increases Versatility by 4% and reduces threat generated by 8%.
scars-of-suffering.desc: 全能提高 4%，产生的仇恨降低 8%。

demonic.name: Demonic
demonic.en: Eye Beam causes you to enter demon form for 5 sec after it finishes dealing damage.
demonic.desc: 眼棱在伤害结束后使你进入恶魔形态，持续 5 秒。

furious-throws.name: Furious Throws
furious-throws.en: Throw Glaive now costs 25 Fury and throws a second glaive at the target.
furious-throws.desc: 投掷利刃现在消耗 25 点怒气，并向目标投出第二把利刃。

trail-of-ruin.name: Trail of Ruin
trail-of-ruin.en: The final slash of Blade Dance inflicts an additional 3,386 Chaos damage.
trail-of-ruin.desc: 刃舞的最后一斩额外造成 3,386 点混乱伤害。

tactical-retreat.name: Tactical Retreat
tactical-retreat.en: Vengeful Retreat has a 5 sec reduced cooldown and generates 80 Fury over 10 sec.
tactical-retreat.desc: 复仇回避的冷却时间降低 5 秒，并在 10 秒内生成 80 点怒气。

blind-fury.name: Blind Fury
blind-fury.en: Eye Beam generates 20 Fury every second, has 20% increased duration, and deals 20% increased damage.
blind-fury.desc: 眼棱每秒生成 20 点怒气，持续时间延长 20%，伤害提高 20%。

furious-gaze.name: Furious Gaze
furious-gaze.en: When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec.
furious-gaze.desc: 完整引导眼棱后，你的急速额外提高 8%，持续 8 秒。

dancing-with-fate.name: Dancing with Fate
dancing-with-fate.en: The final slash of Blade Dance deals an additional 50% damage.
dancing-with-fate.desc: 刃舞的最后一击额外造成 50% 伤害。

growing-inferno.name: Growing Inferno
growing-inferno.en: Immolation Aura's damage increases by 10% each time it deals damage.
growing-inferno.desc: 献祭光环每次造成伤害时，其伤害提高 10%。

exergy.name: Exergy
exergy.en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase your damage by 5% for 20 sec.
exergy.desc: 恶魔追击和复仇回避使你的伤害提高 5%，持续 20 秒。

isolated-prey.name: Isolated Prey
isolated-prey.en: Chaos Nova, Eye Beam, and Immolation Aura gain bonuses when striking 1 target. Chaos Nova: Stun duration increased by 2 sec. Eye Beam: Deals 30% increased damage. Immolation Aura: Always critically strikes.
isolated-prey.desc: 混乱新星、眼棱和献祭光环在只命中 1 个目标时获得加成：混乱新星昏迷延长 2 秒；眼棱伤害提高 30%；献祭光环必定爆击。

the-hunt.name: The Hunt
the-hunt.meta: 1 sec cast · 50 yd range · 1.5 min cooldown
the-hunt.en: Charge to your target, striking them for 46,001 Chaos damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 31,244 Chaos damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.
the-hunt.desc: 冲向目标造成 46,001 点混乱伤害并将其定身 1.5 秒，同时对路径上最多 5 个敌人造成持续 6 秒共 31,244 点混乱伤害。

serrated-glaive.name: Serrated Glaive
serrated-glaive.en: Striking an enemy with Chaos Strike or Throw Glaive increases Chaos Strike and Throw Glaive damage by 15% for 12 sec.
serrated-glaive.desc: 用混乱打击或投掷利刃命中敌人后，混乱打击和投掷利刃对其伤害提高 15%，持续 12 秒。

burning-wound.name: Burning Wound
burning-wound.en: Demon Blades and Throw Glaive leave open wounds on your enemies, dealing 4,103 Chaos damage over 15 sec and increasing damage taken from your Immolation Aura by 35%. May be applied to up to 3 targets.
burning-wound.desc: Demon Blades 和投掷利刃在敌人身上留下创口，在 15 秒内造成 4,103 点混乱伤害，并使其受到你献祭光环的伤害提高 35%。最多同时作用于 3 个目标。

unbound-chaos.name: Unbound Chaos
unbound-chaos.en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase the damage of your next Fel Rush or Felblade by 300%. Lasts 12 sec.
unbound-chaos.desc: 恶魔追击和复仇回避使你的下一次邪能冲撞或邪能之刃伤害提高 300%，持续 12 秒。

inner-demon.name: Inner Demon
inner-demon.en: Entering demon form causes your next Chaos Strike to unleash your inner demon, causing it to crash into your target and deal 11,576 Chaos damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
inner-demon.desc: 进入恶魔形态后，你的下一次混乱打击会释放内心之魔撞向目标，对周围所有敌人造成 11,576 点混乱伤害。超过 5 个目标后伤害降低。

chaotic-transformation.name: Chaotic Transformation
chaotic-transformation.en: When you activate Metamorphosis, the cooldowns of Blade Dance and Eye Beam are immediately reset.
chaotic-transformation.desc: 激活恶魔变形时，刃舞和眼棱的冷却时间立即重置。

soulscar.name: Soulscar
soulscar.en: Throw Glaive causes targets to take an additional 80% of damage dealt as Chaos over 6 sec.
soulscar.desc: 投掷利刃使目标在 6 秒内额外承受所造成伤害 80% 的混乱伤害。

ragefire.name: Ragefire
ragefire.en: Each time Immolation Aura deals damage, 35% of the damage dealt by up to 3 critical strikes is gathered as Ragefire. When Immolation Aura expires you explode, dealing all stored Ragefire damage to nearby enemies.
ragefire.desc: 献祭光环每次造成伤害时，最多 3 次爆击所造成伤害的 35% 会被收集为 Ragefire。献祭光环结束时，你会爆炸把储存的伤害释放给周围敌人。

know-your-enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
know-your-enemy.en: Gain critical strike damage equal to 80% of your critical strike chance.
know-your-enemy.desc: 获得等于你爆击几率 80% 的爆击伤害。

cycle-of-hatred.name: Cycle of Hatred
cycle-of-hatred.en: Activating Eye Beam reduces the cooldown of your next Eye Beam by 2.5 sec, stacking up to 10 sec.
cycle-of-hatred.desc: 激活眼棱使你下一次眼棱的冷却时间降低 2.5 秒，最多叠加至 10 秒。

chaotic-disposition.name: Chaotic Disposition
chaotic-disposition.en: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 7 total times.
chaotic-disposition.desc: 你的混乱伤害有 7.77% 几率提高 17%，最多连续触发 7 次。

essence-break.name: Essence Break
essence-break.en: Slash all enemies in front of you for 21,320 Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal 12,146 Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
essence-break.desc: 斩击前方所有敌人造成 21,320 点混乱伤害，并使混乱打击和刃舞在 4 秒内对其额外造成 12,146 点混乱伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害降低。

glaive-tempest.name: Glaive Tempest
glaive-tempest.en: The final slash of Blade Dance consumes 25 Fury when it strikes 3 or more enemies, launching two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 10,419 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
glaive-tempest.desc: 刃舞的最后一击在命中 3 个或更多敌人时消耗 25 点怒气，投出两把恶魔利刃形成能量漩涡，在 3 秒内对周围敌人造成 10,419 点混乱伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害降低。

shattered-destiny.name: Shattered Destiny
shattered-destiny.en: The duration of your active demon form is extended by 0.1 sec per 12 Fury spent.
shattered-destiny.desc: 你每消耗 12 点怒气，当前恶魔形态的持续时间延长 0.1 秒。

screaming-brutality.name: Screaming Brutality
screaming-brutality.en: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.
screaming-brutality.desc: 刃舞会自动对主要目标触发一次投掷利刃（100% 伤害），且每次斩击有 50% 几率向一个敌人投出利刃（35% 伤害）。

a-fire-inside.name: A Fire Inside
a-fire-inside.en: Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire. You can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.
a-fire-inside.desc: 献祭光环额外获得 1 次充能、冷却时间缩短 6 秒，并改为造成混乱伤害。你可以同时激活多个献祭光环。

eternal-hunt.name: Eternal Hunt
eternal-hunt.en: Rank 1: Blade Dance damage increased by 20%. Fully channeling Eye Beam causes your next Blade Dance to refresh its own cooldown. Rank 3: The Hunt has 60 sec reduced cooldown, deals 60% more damage, and its damage over time effect applies to 8 additional enemies. Rank 4: The Hunt empowers your next Eye Beam, increasing damage by 100% and affecting enemies in a wider area.
eternal-hunt.desc: 第 1 级：刃舞伤害提高 20%，完整引导眼棱使你的下一次刃舞刷新自身冷却。第 3 级：恶魔追击的冷却时间降低 60 秒、伤害提高 60%，其持续伤害额外作用于 8 个敌人。第 4 级：恶魔追击强化你的下一次眼棱，伤害提高 100% 并影响更大范围。

demonsurge.name: Demonsurge
demonsurge.en: Metamorphosis now also causes Demon Blades to generate 3 additional Fury. While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Demonsurge, causing you to explode with Fel energy, dealing 15,190 Chaos damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
demonsurge.desc: 恶魔变形使 Demon Blades 额外生成 3 点怒气。恶魔形态激活时，每个被强化技能的首次施放都会触发一次魔涌，以邪能爆炸对周围敌人造成 15,190 点混乱伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害降低。

wave-of-debilitation.name: Wave of Debilitation
wave-of-debilitation.en: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.
wave-of-debilitation.desc: 混乱新星使敌人减速 60%，并在昏迷结束后的 5 秒内使其攻击和施法速度降低 15%。

focused-hatred.name: Focused Hatred
focused-hatred.en: Demonsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target. Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.
focused-hatred.desc: 魔涌在只命中一个目标时伤害提高 50%，每多一个目标该加成降低 10%。

set-fire-to-the-pain.name: Set Fire to the Pain
set-fire-to-the-pain.en: 5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec. Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.
set-fire-to-the-pain.desc: 你受到的所有非火焰伤害的 5% 改为在 6 秒内以火焰伤害形式承受。受到的火焰伤害降低 10%。

blind-focus.name: Blind Focus
blind-focus.en: Fire damage increased by 5%. Effect is doubled while in demon form.
blind-focus.desc: 火焰伤害提高 5%，处于恶魔形态时此效果翻倍。

burning-blades.name: Burning Blades
burning-blades.en: Your blades burn with Fel energy, causing the damage from Chaos Strike, Throw Glaive, Blade Dance's First Blood, and auto-attacks to burn for an additional 35% damage as Fire over 6 sec.
burning-blades.desc: 你的刀刃被邪能点燃，使混乱打击、投掷利刃、刃舞的第一滴血和自动攻击在 6 秒内额外燃烧 35% 的火焰伤害。

violent-transformation.name: Violent Transformation
violent-transformation.en: When you activate Metamorphosis, reset the cooldown of Immolation Aura.
violent-transformation.desc: 激活恶魔变形时，献祭光环的冷却时间重置。

enduring-torment.name: Enduring Torment
enduring-torment.en: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance damage by 15%, and Haste by 5%.
enduring-torment.desc: 你的恶魔形态效果在形态外以削弱状态延续，使混乱打击和刃舞伤害提高 15%、急速提高 5%。

undying-embers.name: Undying Embers
undying-embers.en: Immolation Aura has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.
undying-embers.desc: 献祭光环有 25% 几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

student-of-suffering.name: Student of Suffering
student-of-suffering.en: Eye Beam applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 18.0% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.
student-of-suffering.desc: 眼棱使你获得 Student of Suffering：6 秒内精通提高 18%，且每 2 秒生成 5 点怒气。

monster-rising.name: Monster Rising
monster-rising.en: Agility increased by 8% while not in demon form.
monster-rising.desc: 不在恶魔形态时，敏捷提高 8%。

volatile-instinct.name: Volatile Instinct
volatile-instinct.en: Entering demon form immediately induces a Demonsurge.
volatile-instinct.desc: 进入恶魔形态立即触发一次魔涌。

demonic-intensity.name: Demonic Intensity
demonic-intensity.en: Activating Metamorphosis greatly empowers Eye Beam, Immolation Aura. Demonsurge damage is increased by 5% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.
demonic-intensity.desc: 激活恶魔变形会大幅强化眼棱和献祭光环。恶魔形态激活期间，魔涌的伤害每次触发提高 5%。

art-of-the-glaive.name: Art of the Glaive
art-of-the-glaive.en: Consuming 6 Soul Fragments or casting The Hunt converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive. Reaver's Glaive: Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 20,604 Physical damage and ricocheting to 3 additional enemies. Begins a well-practiced pattern of glaivework, enhancing your next Chaos Strike and Blade Dance. The enhanced ability you cast first deals 10% increased damage, and the second deals 20% increased damage. Generates 20 Fury.
art-of-the-glaive.desc: 消耗 6 个灵魂碎片或施放恶魔追击后，你的下一次投掷利刃变为 Reaver's Glaive：投出被灵魂精华强化的利刃，造成 20,604 点物理伤害并弹跳到 3 个额外目标，同时开启一套强化循环——你接下来施放的第一个强化技能伤害提高 10%，第二个提高 20%。生成 20 点怒气。

fury-of-the-aldrachi.name: Fury of the Aldrachi
fury-of-the-aldrachi.en: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Blade Dance casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. If cast after Chaos Strike, cast 6 slashes instead.
fury-of-the-aldrachi.desc: 被 Reaver's Glaive 强化时，刃舞向附近目标额外投出 3 道利刃斩击；若在混乱打击之后施放则变为 6 道。超过 8 个目标后伤害降低。

unhindered-assault.name: Unhindered Assault
unhindered-assault.en: Vengeful Retreat resets the cooldown of Felblade.
unhindered-assault.desc: 复仇回避重置邪能之刃的冷却时间。

reaver's-mark.name: Reaver's Mark
reaver's-mark.en: When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Chaos Strike applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 6% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 3 stacks. Applies 2 additional stacks of Reaver's Mark If cast after Blade Dance.
reaver's-mark.desc: 被 Reaver's Glaive 强化时，混乱打击对目标施加 Reaver's Mark，使其在 20 秒内受到的伤害提高 6%，最多 3 层；若在刃舞之后施放则额外施加 2 层。

broken-spirit.name: Broken Spirit
broken-spirit.en: The Hunt shatters 1 Soul Fragment. Blade Dance and Chaos Strike have a 15% chance to shatter a Soul Fragment.
broken-spirit.desc: 恶魔追击破碎 1 个灵魂碎片。刃舞和混乱打击有 15% 几率破碎一个灵魂碎片。

aldrachi-tactics.name: Aldrachi Tactics
aldrachi-tactics.en: The second enhanced ability in a pattern shatters an additional Soul Fragment.
aldrachi-tactics.desc: 一套循环中的第二个强化技能额外破碎一个灵魂碎片。

army-unto-oneself.name: Army Unto Oneself
army-unto-oneself.en: Felblade surrounds you with a Blade Ward, reducing damage taken by 10% for 5 sec.
army-unto-oneself.desc: 邪能之刃为你施加 Blade Ward，在 5 秒内使受到的伤害降低 10%。

wounded-quarry.name: Wounded Quarry
wounded-quarry.en: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
wounded-quarry.desc: 暴露 Reaver's Mark 目标的弱点，使你对任何敌人造成的物理伤害同时对被标记目标造成 30% 的混乱伤害，并有时破碎一个灵魂碎片。

keen-edge.name: Keen Edge
keen-edge.en: Reaver's Glaive damage is increased by 20% and other Physical-only damage is increased by 10%.
keen-edge.desc: Reaver's Glaive 的伤害提高 20%，其他纯物理伤害提高 10%。

keen-engagement.name: Keen Engagement
keen-engagement.desc: Reaver's Glaive 生成 20 点怒气。

bladecraft.name: Bladecraft
bladecraft.en: Fury of the Aldrachi further empowers Blade Dance when cast after Chaos Strike, increasing slashes to 12. Reaver's Mark now stacks up to 3 times and further empowers Chaos Strike when cast after Blade Dance, applying an additional stack.
bladecraft.desc: Fury of the Aldrachi 在混乱打击之后施放刃舞时进一步强化，斩击增加到 12 道。Reaver's Mark 最多叠加 3 层，且在刃舞之后施放混乱打击时额外施加一层。

warblade's-hunger.name: Warblade's Hunger
warblade's-hunger.en: Consuming a Soul Fragment causes your next Chaos Strike to deal 2,016 additional Physical damage. Felblade consumes up to 5 nearby Soul Fragments.
warblade's-hunger.desc: 消耗一个灵魂碎片使你的下一次混乱打击额外造成 2,016 点物理伤害。邪能之刃最多消耗 5 个附近的灵魂碎片。

thrill-of-the-fight.name: Thrill of the Fight
thrill-of-the-fight.en: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.
thrill-of-the-fight.desc: 消耗两个强化后获得 Thrill of the Fight：你的下一次 Reaver's Glaive 伤害提高 30%，且急速提高 8%，持续 30 秒。

cleansed-by-flame.name: Cleansed by Flame
cleansed-by-flame.en: Immolation Aura dispels a magical effect on you when cast.
cleansed-by-flame.desc: 献祭光环在施放时驱散你身上的一个魔法效果。

reverse-magic.name: Reverse Magic
reverse-magic.en: Removes all harmful magical effects from yourself and all nearby allies within 10 yards, and sends them back to their original caster if possible.
reverse-magic.desc: 移除你和周围 10 码内所有盟友身上的所有有害魔法效果，并尽可能将其反弹给原施法者。

rain-from-above.name: Rain from Above
rain-from-above.en: You fly into the air out of harm's way. While floating, you gain access to Fel Lance allowing you to deal damage to enemies below.
rain-from-above.desc: 你飞到空中躲避伤害。浮空期间可以使用 Fel Lance 对下方敌人造成伤害。

detainment.name: Detainment
detainment.en: Imprison's PvP duration is increased by 1 sec, and targets become immune to damage and healing while imprisoned.
detainment.desc: 禁锢在 PvP 中的持续时间延长 1 秒，且被禁锢的目标免疫伤害和治疗。

glimpse.name: Glimpse
glimpse.en: Vengeful Retreat provides immunity to loss of control effects, and reduces damage taken by 25% until you land.
glimpse.desc: 复仇回避提供失控效果免疫，并在你落地前使受到的伤害降低 25%。

cover-of-darkness.name: Cover of Darkness
cover-of-darkness.en: The radius of Darkness is increased by 4 yds, and its duration by 2 sec.
cover-of-darkness.desc: 黑暗的范围扩大 4 码，持续时间延长 2 秒。

unending-hatred.name: Unending Hatred
unending-hatred.en: Taking damage causes you to gain Fury based on the damage dealt.
unending-hatred.desc: 受到伤害时按伤害量获得怒气。

blood-moon.name: Blood Moon
blood-moon.en: Consume Magic now affects all enemies within 8 yards of the target and generates a Lesser Soul Fragment. Each effect consumed has a 5% chance to upgrade to a Greater Soul.
blood-moon.desc: Consume Magic 现在影响目标周围 8 码内的所有敌人并生成一个次级灵魂碎片。每个被消耗的效果有 5% 几率升级为 Greater Soul。

sigil-mastery.name: Sigil Mastery
sigil-mastery.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Sigils by an additional 25%.
sigil-mastery.desc: 你的咒符冷却时间额外降低 25%。

illidan's-grasp.name: Illidan's Grasp
illidan's-grasp.en: You strangle the target with demonic magic, stunning them in place and dealing 392 Shadow damage over 5 sec while the target is grasped. Can move while channeling. Use Illidan's Grasp again to toss the target to a location within 20 yards.
illidan's-grasp.desc: 用恶魔魔法束缚目标，使其昏迷在原地并在 5 秒内造成 392 点暗影伤害。引导期间可以移动，再次使用可将目标投掷到 20 码内的位置。
